Woodworking & Carpentry Services

From singular heirloom dining tables to comprehensive architectural joinery packages, we bring thoughtful design and uncompromising craftsmanship to every project.

Heirloom Joinery

Custom Furniture

We craft bespoke freestanding furniture built to exact client specifications. Each dining table, desk, credenza, and coffee table is designed around how you live and engineered with solid mortise-and-tenon or dovetail joinery.

Capabilities & Scope

  • Custom dining tables (solid slab, trestle, extending)
  • Executive work desks and home study furniture
  • Low coffee tables, side tables, and nightstands
  • Media credenzas, sideboards, and display consoles
  • Hand-applied natural hardwax oils and matte urethane finishes

Architectural Storage

Built-in Wardrobes

Tailored wardrobe architecture designed around awkward alcoves, sloped ceilings, and complex master bedroom layouts. We maximize vertical capacity with thoughtful interior partitions, cedar-lined hanging bays, and integrated lighting.

Capabilities & Scope

  • Full floor-to-ceiling fitted bedroom wardrobe suites
  • Custom internal drawer units with soft-close Blum hardware
  • Integrated LED illumination with automatic door sensors
  • Linen closet and dressing room configurations
  • Solid wood shaker, flat-panel, or reed-profile door fronts
Request a Quote for Built-in Wardrobes

Culinary Joinery

Kitchen Cabinetry

Bespoke kitchen cabinetry fabricated from solid hardwood face frames and premium birch-ply carcasses. We design kitchens that look stunning and stand up to daily culinary heat, moisture, and high-frequency use.

Capabilities & Scope

  • Custom floor and wall cabinetry to custom non-standard dimensions
  • Island units with butcher block or waterfall end panels
  • Concealed appliance pantries and pull-out spice systems
  • Solid dovetail maple drawer boxes on heavy-duty runners
  • Durable non-toxic, moisture-resistant protective coatings

Functional Elegance

Shelving & Storage

From discreet floating shelves with hidden steel rod supports to monumental wall-to-wall library shelving, we create functional storage that transforms blank walls into stunning visual features.

Capabilities & Scope

  • Heavy-duty floating solid timber shelves with invisible brackets
  • Floor-to-ceiling library bookcases with rolling ladder rails
  • Vinyl record consoles and audiophile display shelving
  • Architectural alcove shelving with recessed downlighting
  • Modular wall-mounted timber storage cubbies

Architectural Detailing

Interior Woodwork

Elevate your interior architecture with custom wooden paneling, solid timber internal doors, baseboards, architraves, and acoustic timber slat wall treatments crafted with millimeter precision.

Capabilities & Scope

  • Custom interior solid wood pivot doors and sliding barn doors
  • Acoustic slatted timber feature walls and ceiling baffles
  • Bespoke wainscoting, board-and-batten, and tongue-and-groove paneling
  • Handcrafted window sills, casing, and custom crown molding
  • Structural timber beam claddings and column wraps

Hospitality & Retail

Commercial Woodwork

We collaborate with architects, interior designers, and business owners to produce high-impact wooden fixtures for cafés, boutiques, corporate offices, restaurants, and hospitality environments.

Capabilities & Scope

  • Custom coffee shop counters and espresso service bars
  • Corporate boardroom conference tables with wire-management bays
  • Retail display units, vitrines, and boutique merchandising shelving

Preservation & Care

Furniture Restoration

Preserve treasured vintage and antique wooden furniture. We offer meticulous structural repair, sympathetic grain-matching veneer repairs, finish removal, and traditional hand-rubbed shellac and oil restoration.

Capabilities & Scope

  • Wobbly chair and table frame dismantling, regluing, and joint reinforcement
  • Gentle chemical-free surface stripping and hand sanding
  • Historic finish replication (French polish, Danish oil, wax)
  • Missing carved molding and veneer patch reproduction
  • Water ring, burn, and surface scratch rectification
Request a Quote for Furniture Restoration

Sustainable Materials

Honest Timber Sourcing

The foundation of enduring woodwork is stable, properly kiln-dried lumber. We prioritize locally harvested, sustainably managed North American hardwoods.

Discuss Your Timber Preferences

American White Oak

Dense, water-resistant, with striking medullary ray flecks. Ideal for dining tables, flooring, and kitchen cabinetry.

Black Walnut

Rich chocolate and amber tones with deep figuring. A premium choice for executive furniture and accent cabinetry.

Hard Rock Maple

Exceptionally fine grain, pale blond coloration, and incredible hardness. Excellent for culinary butcher blocks and drawer carcasses.

Pacific Douglas Fir

Warm reddish hues, tight vertical grain lines, and distinctive West Coast character for architectural wall paneling and interior beams.
